lines.en: Hi Omar! It has been such a long time. How have you been?
Hi Sara! I am great. I have been working in marketing for five years, and I feel ready for more responsibility.
That is wonderful. What is your main goal these days?
My main goal is to become a team leader by next year, if the company agrees.
If you get the promotion, you will have more responsibility, but less free time.
I know. But setting clear goals helps me measure my progress and stay motivated when work gets difficult.
How is your manager these days? Still strict?
She is strict about deadlines, but I respect her because she is fair with everyone.
I admire people who stay calm in difficult situations and never blame others for their mistakes.
Me too. And I have learned that first impressions are not always correct, so I give people a chance before judging them.
Wise words. By the way, did you hear about the new airport that is being built near the city?
Yes! I try to read the news every morning, because I like to know what is happening in the world.
Just remember, not everything you see on social media is true, so always check where the information comes from.
Of course. I am worried about the economic situation, especially for young people looking for their first job.
Let's talk about something happier. Did you travel anywhere this year?
I went to Greece, but our flight was delayed by three hours because of bad weather, so we missed our connection.
Oh no! That sounds exhausting.
It was. We had to wait four hours for the next flight, and my luggage did not arrive until the next day.
If you had left earlier, you would not have been stuck in all that.
True. But despite all the problems we had on the way, we really enjoyed the trip.
That is the right attitude. You look healthier too. Are you doing something different?
I used to drink a lot of soda, but I stopped last year, and now I feel more energetic.
Regular exercise reduces stress and improves your mood, which is why many doctors recommend it.
And I take a short walk after dinner; it helps digestion, and it clears my mind after a long day.
A balanced lifestyle is more important than a strict diet, because you can keep it up for years.
Exactly. Are you still taking that online course you told me about?
Yes. Learning a new skill takes time, but it becomes easier once you start using it every day.
In my opinion, practical skills are just as important as a university degree when you look for a job.
I agree. Reading books regularly also improves your vocabulary and helps you express your ideas more clearly.
Whether you learn at school or by yourself, the most important thing is to stay curious and keep going.
Speaking of learning, my sister uploads an educational video every week, and she hopes to make a living from it one day.
Social media makes it easy to reach people, but it can also waste a lot of time.
I check my phone first thing in the morning, which is a habit I am trying to change.
Although online friendships can be real, I believe nothing replaces meeting someone face to face.
Like us now! Did you read about the environment conference last week?
Yes. If we do not reduce pollution soon, the air in big cities will become even more dangerous.
I try to use public transport whenever I can, because it is better for the environment and cheaper than driving.
Small changes in our daily habits may not seem important, but together they can make a real difference.
Governments should invest more in solar energy, since Egypt has sunshine for most of the year.
Changing the subject, are you still gathering with your family on Fridays?
Always. We gather for a big lunch, and everyone brings a different dish.
Traditions give us a sense of belonging, especially when we are far away from home.
My grandmother taught me how to bake traditional bread, and I hope to teach my children one day.
That is beautiful. Some customs change over the years, but the most important values stay the same.
By the way, I finally returned that jacket I told you about. The zip broke the first time I wore it.
Did you get your money back?
I complained politely, and the company offered me a replacement as well as a small discount.
Good result. I usually compare prices online before I buy anything expensive, because it can save me a lot of money.
It is not always worth paying more for a famous brand, since cheaper products are often just as good.
This conversation is bringing back memories. Do you remember our school trips?
How could I forget? When I was a child, we used to spend every summer at my grandparents' house by the sea.
The best day of my life was when I graduated, because my whole family was there to celebrate with me.
Looking back, I think failing that math exam taught me more than passing it ever could.
Some memories fade with time, while others stay with us for the rest of our lives.
Speaking of memories, my cousin wants to quit his job. What would you advise him?
If I were him, I would talk to his manager before making any decision about leaving the company.
I told him he had better start preparing first, otherwise he will be stressed when the time comes.
Whatever he decides, he should make sure it is his own choice, not something other people expect from him.
Taking advice is easy, but it takes courage to change the way you have been doing things for years.
He is also choosing between two apartments; one is cheaper while the other is closer to work.
When you have too many options, it is better to write down the advantages and disadvantages of each one.
The more I think about it, the more I believe the quieter place is the safer choice for him.
Living in a small town is not as exciting as living in a big city, but it is certainly calmer.
Let's hope he chooses well. Have you seen how fast technology is changing our lives?
Artificial intelligence is already changing the way we work, and it will probably change it even more.
Smartphones have made our lives easier, but they have also made it harder to disconnect from work.
It is important to protect your personal data, because companies collect far more information than you realize.
Technology is only a tool, and whether it helps or harms us depends on how we choose to use it.
Talking about work reminded me: how is your budget plan going?
At the end of every month, I write down what I spent, so I can see where my money went.
It is much easier to save money when you have a clear goal, such as buying a car or travelling.
Having a budget does not mean you cannot enjoy life; it simply means you spend with a plan.
I would rather spend money on experiences than on things that I will forget about in a few months.
Being rich is not only about how much you earn, but also about how wisely you manage what you have.
Wise again. Oh, before I forget, how did your brother's interview go?
He was nervous, but he had practiced his answers so many times that he felt confident.
The interviewer asked him why he wanted to work for their company, I suppose?
Exactly. And they told him they would call him by the end of the week.
Dressing well for an interview shows that you take the opportunity seriously, and he always dresses smartly.
Whether they choose him or not, he is glad he had the experience.
My week was all meetings. The big one was moved to Thursday because the manager was traveling.
During our last meeting, we discussed how we could reduce our costs next year.
If you cannot attend Thursday, please let us know at least one day in advance.
I will be there. By the time the meeting ended last time, everyone had agreed on the new plan.
It was decided that all future meetings would be held online, which saves us the commute.
So, any big dreams left on your list?
Ever since I was a child, I have dreamed of starting my own business.
Unless you try, you will never know how far you can go.
I am saving money so that I can study abroad next year, and then I will start.
My biggest dream is not to be rich, but to do work that helps people.
When we finally achieve our goals, we will look back and be proud of the journey.
Before we forget, what are the rules for the new co-working space you joined?
Members must wear their badges at all times while they are in the building.
Are guests allowed, or do they need a special permit?
Visitors are required to sign in at the reception desk before entering.
The rules were made to protect everyone, even if they sometimes feel strict.
True. So, what do you predict for next year?
It is likely that more people will work from home in the coming years.
I doubt that prices will go down any time soon, so I am trying to save more.
Nobody knows what the future will bring, but we can prepare for it.
I predict that online learning will become more common than traditional classrooms.
Whatever happens, the world will keep changing faster than we expect.
On a practical note, will you show me how to make that famous bread of yours?
Of course. First, you mix the flour with warm water, and then you let it rest.
Do I knead it before or after it rests?
After. Once the dough rises, it is divided into small balls and left again.
And I should not open the oven while it is baking, or the bread will sink, right?
Exactly. If you follow the steps in order, the whole process takes about an hour.
I am so sorry, I just realized I am late for a family lunch.
Do not worry. I would have reminded you, but I was enjoying the conversation too much.
I apologize for rushing off like this.
It is fine. I hope your family accepts my apology for keeping you so long.
They will. Next time I will leave earlier so that this does not happen again.
Before you go, do you agree that we should meet every month from now on?
I completely agree with you; that is exactly what I was thinking.
I could not agree more with your idea of taking turns choosing the place.
If anyone suggests otherwise, let us agree to disagree and keep our plan.
After all these years, our friendship turned out to be the best story of all.
It started a long time ago, when we were still students at university.
In the end, everything worked out better than we had expected.
Looking back at this level, I am surprised by how much my English has improved.
The more you practice speaking, the more confident you will become.
And that is how I learned never to give up, no matter how hard things get.
Take care, Sara. See you next month!
See you, Omar. It was wonderful talking to you, as always.
